copy.curiosityHook: What begins as an uneasy confrontation shifts the moment Valentine catches the reclusive judge secretly wiretapping private neighborhood conversations.
copy.description: After accidentally injuring a dog, part-time model Valentine meets its detached owner, a retired judge. When she discovers he routinely eavesdrops on his neighbors, an improbable connection begins to form.
copy.vibeSummary: Thoughtful, deliberate, and emotionally resonant French drama laced with quiet, voyeuristic mystery.
copy.whyWatch: Director Krzysztof Kieślowski crafts an intimate, slow-burning drama that folds quiet suspense and genuine emotional warmth into an unconventional moral encounter.

allowedMaterial: Valentine running over the dog and keeping it
The discovery of the judge eavesdropping on his neighbors' phone calls
The emergence of an unlikely bond between the two characters
excludedMaterial: Content or consequences of the intercepted phone calls
